# Serpent meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: SerpentMeat | Source: Serpent | Usage: Iron cooking station | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Serpent meat is a guaranteed drop from Serpents, and drops in quantities of 6-7. It can be cooked on an Iron cooking station to obtain Cooked serpent meat and be eaten or crafted into other foods.

## Availability

• Creature: Serpent | 0 Star: 6-7

#### For Serpent meat

• Cooked serpent meat
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long

#### For Cooked serpent meat

• Serpent stew
• Sailor's bounty
Unlike most other foods made from meat, Serpent meat has to be cooked on an Iron cooking station first to be crafted into other foods.

## Notes

• Serpent meat floats. It can remain floating for a considerable period. If the player kills a Serpent during a storm but cannot pick up the meat at the time, return as soon as possible and the meat may still be recoverable.
• As Serpent stew provides more health and stamina, eating the meat is not ideal unless in excess of it.
• The stew's constituent ingredients are easily obtainable, with Mushrooms able to be foraged from Meadows and Black Forests, while the Honey can be obtained from Beehives.
• A player eating Serpent meat may want to limit the amount of it they carry, as each one is much heavier than any other foods.

Categorias: Materials, Food
